"In addition to the framework review and revision, this third edition features several major changes and new material on process management, quality management systems - ISO 9000:2000, human resource management, performance measurement, partnerships &​ resources, innovation &​ learning, knowledge management and benchmarking."--BOOK JACKET. # "The third edition of TQM: Text with Cases is the result of extensive revision of the second edition. Even John Oakland's famous TQM Model has been revised to reflect developments in the field and the growing importance of the so-called 'Excellence' frameworks." "As with previous editions, the book is written in a logical and practical style, supported by eleven real life case studies, reflecting the latest developments from leading exponents of TQM and Business Excellence. Seven of the cases are brand new. Through all this, Professor Oakland demonstrates how a total quality or business excellence strategy can be applied in all activities to achieve world-class performance."
